text-xs.usage: Fine print: footer details, crumbs, tags, pop-up notes.

text-sm.usage: Small UI text: chips, credentials, links in pop-ups.

text-md.usage: Buttons, menu labels, card titles, list lines in the hero.

text-lg.usage: Leads under a title; bigger card titles.

text-xl.usage: The hero's lead line; pop-up titles; Simone's name.

text-kid.usage: Anything a child reads: instructions, labels, steps. Never under 14pt on paper.

text-display.usage: The practice name in the home page hero.

gutter.usage: Space between the page edge and the content.

section-space.usage: Top and bottom padding of every section band.

section-top.usage: Top padding of a section band, above its title (the wave already adds air).

stack.usage: Space between groups: under a section title, and between the blocks of a worksheet.

group-gap.usage: Space between a heading and the thing it introduces, so they read as one group (always smaller than stack).

grid-gap.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.
